study: Matched neural contraction-metric learning on the two-machine swing model
baseline_name: Fitzsimmons--Liu PDI objective, controlled common-class/common-verifier adaptation
implementation: Independent equation-based implementation; no external source code copied

primary_source.title: Computation and Formal Verification of Neural Network Contraction Metrics

controlled_adaptations: Use the same six-unit tanh triangular factor and 39 parameters for all three compared arms; M=0.1 I+L^T L replaces the original direct symmetric output.
Set S=0.1 I, so the positivity penalty is identically zero by the common representation.
Use R=C_lambda+q I with lambda=0.05 and q=0.01 to match the common target-rate matrix condition. This replaces original Q=I by Q=2 lambda M+q I.
Use the same fixed boxes [-B,B]^2, B in {0.25,0.5,0.75}, instead of independently learned invariant Lyapunov sublevel sets.
Use 20 shared seeds, 512 shared initial samples, five rounds of 400 Adam steps, batch size 512, learning rate 0.01, and reset Adam state per round.

PDI baseline and normalized-hinge fixed-data control retain the fixed initial collocation set. The normalized-hinge CEGIS arm adds at most 64 returned diagnostic points per round. All arms receive the same verifier call schedule and per-call budget.

All arms use the same outward-rounded verifier with prescribed raw margin 0.0001 instead of dReal. The comparison does not compare complete external tools or reproduce published certified region sizes.

All learner objectives have the same pointwise zero set lambda_max(C_lambda)<=-q. The PDI versus CEGIS comparison changes spectral aggregation, squaring/normalization, and diagnostic feedback. The normalized-hinge fixed-data control holds the objective fixed to isolate diagnostic-feedback effects under the shared budget.

upstream_access.result: Repository, raw-file, and git accesses redirected to sign-in or required authentication. No original contraction implementation or commit was obtained.
upstream_access.consequence: No claim of running author code or reproducing the original end-to-end experiment.

interpretation: This is a matched comparison of a published learning objective against the present sampled-hinge CEGIS configuration under a shared representation and verifier. It does not isolate any single component unless supplemented by a separate control, and does not establish superiority over the original Fitzsimmons--Liu or Davydov methods.
certification_semantics: All training arithmetic is heuristic binary64. Only the common outward-rounded verifier can give a positive certificate; time/budget exhaustion is inconclusive.

arms.pdi_fixed: Published PDI objective adaptation with fixed collocation data
arms.hinge_fixed: Internal normalized max-eigenvalue hinge control with fixed collocation data; not an external method
arms.hinge_cegis: Same normalized hinge with diagnostic-point dataset augmentation
